formulas.name: fContactId
formulas.expression: IF(AND({!Rad_Account} = "Use Existing Account", {!Rad_Contact} = "Use Existing Contact"), IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Lkp_Contact.recordId})), {!Lkp_Contact.recordId}, {!fSuggestedContactId}), "")

formulas.name: fOppName
formulas.expression: IF(IF({!Rad_Account} = "Use Existing Account", {!Rad_Opp} = "Create New Opportunity", {!Rad_Opp_New_Only} = "Create New Opportunity"), {!Inp_Opp_Name}, "")

formulas.name: fDoNotCreateOpp
formulas.expression: IF({!Rad_Account} = "Use Existing Account", {!Rad_Opp} = "Do Not Create an Opportunity", {!Rad_Opp_New_Only} = "Do Not Create an Opportunity")

formulas.name: fAcctSuggestNeedsLookup
formulas.expression: AND({!Rad_Account} = "Use Existing Account", ISBLANK({!Lkp_Account.recordId}), NOT(ISBLANK({!Rad_Acct_Suggest})), NOT(BEGINS({!Rad_Acct_Suggest}, "001")), NOT(CONTAINS({!Rad_Acct_Suggest}, "href=")))

formulas.name: fConSuggestNeedsLookup
formulas.expression: AND({!Rad_Account} = "Use Existing Account", {!Rad_Contact} = "Use Existing Contact", ISBLANK({!Lkp_Contact.recordId}), NOT(ISBLANK({!Rad_Con_Suggest})), NOT(BEGINS({!Rad_Con_Suggest}, "003")), NOT(CONTAINS({!Rad_Con_Suggest}, "href=")))
